name: twenty-mcp-server
description: Discover, read, and manage Twenty CRM records and workflows through MCP.
long_description: A metadata-driven MCP server for Twenty CRM. It supports standard and custom objects, CRM search and aggregation, people, companies, opportunities, tasks, notes, lists, outreach sequences with conditions, Yes/No branches, automated/manual actions, LinkedIn steps and phone enrichment, email and campaigns, dashboards, saved views, record activity timelines, LinkedIn action queues, and Unibox reads. Risky, bulk, and outbound operations require explicit confirmation, while irreversible and high-volume tools are opt-in.

base_url.title: Twenty base URL
base_url.description: Twenty Cloud uses https://api.twenty.com. For self-hosted Twenty, enter the origin without /rest or /graphql.

api_key.title: Twenty API key
api_key.description: A role-scoped API key created under Settings > API & Webhooks.

user_token.title: Twenty user token
user_token.description: Optional user-scoped token for connected accounts, email, drafts, record timelines, Unibox, and user-owned LinkedIn records. Leave blank for API-key-only use.

enable_advanced.title: Enable advanced tools
enable_advanced.description: Expose permanent record destruction and high-volume attachment/message read tools.
